title: Solving a leakage challenge for a compartment lunch box
challenge: Leakage was observed in the reference sample and in an alternative supplier sample. Reliable leak performance was therefore a key requirement for the project.
approach: MayLendy developed samples and worked through mold development and product adjustments with the customer. The team refined the product through testing and iteration before completing the mold.
result: The product made with the completed mold passed the project’s leak test.
summary: After leakage was found in initial samples, MayLendy worked with a European supermarket-channel customer on sample and mold adjustments. The final compartment lunch box passed the project’s leak test.

title: A nesting set designed for more efficient shipping
challenge: The customer wanted a coordinated set that could make better use of shipping space.
approach: MayLendy arranged the set so that one larger tray could hold two smaller-sized containers, creating a compact, organized configuration.
result: The nesting arrangement made more efficient use of the available shipping space.
summary: For a North American gifting-channel customer, MayLendy arranged a stainless steel storage set so that one larger tray could hold two smaller containers — making better use of shipping space.
